evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

rows.mappingNote: New light-bulb article, 電球 でんきゅう 1443170:1.
rows.sourceNote: Separate the light-producing component from an entire lamp and its illumination. Do not restrict the word to incandescent or perfectly spherical bulbs.

rows.mappingNote: New score/points article, 点数 てんすう 1441660:1; explicitly teach number-of-items sense2.
rows.sourceNote: Numerical scoring and counting articles are distinct uses. Compare complete 点/成績/数/数字 families and their actual existing bodies rather than only their first title gloss.

rows.mappingNote: New infection/contagion article, 伝染 でんせん 1442110:1.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive transmission; actual public body supports figurative contagious yawning. Existing 移る also has infection sense2 despite its relocation-focused article. Do not claim every spread is infection.

rows.mappingNote: New battery/electric-cell article, 電池 でんち 1443620:1.
rows.sourceNote: Do not define batteries as necessarily disposable or nonrechargeable. Public body includes physical and solar cells. Add reciprocal 池 example links on both reading and Common words surfaces.

rows.mappingNote: New scattered-here-and-there article, 点々 てんてん 1598460:1; recognize 点点 and noun dots/spots sense2.
rows.sourceNote: Do not expand raw little-by-little into unrestricted gradual improvement. Actual public senses concern scattering, intervals, drops or dots. Keep the independent 転々 identity separate.

rows.mappingNote: New successive-moves/pass-around article, 転々 てんてん 1704220:1; recognize rolling sense2 and 転転.
rows.sourceNote: Raw source gloss is empty; do not invent a source value. Successive relocations differ from scattered 点々; the identical reading does not establish a synonym edge. A one-off move does not itself establish the repeated transitions.

rows.mappingNote: New utility-pole article, 電柱 でんちゅう 1443630:1.
rows.sourceNote: Supporting overhead wires, not every roadside post or lamp. Material is not fixed. Add reciprocal 柱 links without replacing its old 支柱 example.

rows.mappingNote: New Emperor-of-Japan title article, 天皇 てんのう 1582030:1.
rows.sourceNote: The actual てんのう public heading explains てんおう to てんのう through 連声; 皇 has on コウ/オウ, not an independent ノウ reading. Do not merge unrelated historical headings or generalize the national title to all emperors.

rows.mappingNote: New radio-wave/reception article, 電波 でんぱ 1443720:1; separately recognize slang sense2.
rows.sourceNote: Radio sense restricted to でんぱ. Kana-only デンパ/デムパ do not authorize ordinary radio reading デムパ. Public technical body concerns radio-frequency radiation, not every electromagnetic wave. Add reciprocal 波 links.

rows.mappingNote: New musical-tempo article, テンポ 1081120:1; actual public katakana heading also supports activity pace.
rows.sourceNote: Italian loan; not unrelated 店舗/塡補 headings from a mixed page. Distinguish rhythm's pattern from tempo's speed. Public pace use does not invent an additional JMdict sense index.

rows.mappingNote: New electric-current article, 電流 でんりゅう 1443790:1.
rows.sourceNote: Charge flow, amperes, not voltage or power. Compare both electrical DC/AC senses, including 交流's secondary sense beyond its social title. Add no electrical handling instructions.

rows.mappingNote: New electric-power article, 電力 でんりょく 1443810:1.
rows.sourceNote: Power is energy per unit time, measured in watts, not current or accumulated energy. Contextual electricity overlap does not collapse those quantities.

rows.mappingNote: New native inquiry/query noun article, 問い合わせ といあわせ 1598590:1.
rows.sourceNote: Recognize 問合せ/問い合せ/問合わせ; search-only 問合 is not an ordinary example recommendation. Practical 問い合わせをする pattern does not prove every direct suru construction impossible. ENQ is not the general teaching definition.

rows.mappingNote: New copper article, 銅 どう 1582390:1; teach medal abbreviation sense2 only for どう.
rows.sourceNote: Preserve あか/あかがね reading restrictions and 赤金 spelling recognition; do not transfer medal sense to あかがね. Existing どう adverb is unrelated. Copper, bronze alloy and copper coins are not identical materials/objects. Add 銅 reciprocity.

rows.mappingNote: New unification/uniformity article, 統一 とういつ 1449670:1.
rows.sourceNote: Transitive suru with object and standard. Existing 一致 includes unity sense2; 合同 includes merger. Compare those whole families rather than only agreement/joint-work labels. Raw compatible does not establish an unrestricted adjective.

rows.mappingNote: New equal-rank article, 同格 どうかく 1452000:1; bounded grammatical apposition sense2.
rows.sourceNote: Same standing is not identity in every property. Noun/no/na construction evidence does not impose exclusive suffix use. Grammatical apposition identifies a common referent rather than equal workplace rank.

rows.mappingNote: New native mountain-pass and critical-peak article, 峠 とうげ 1454420:1-2.
rows.sourceNote: A pass need not be the mountain summit or a whole ridge. 峠を越える can concern the crisis peak without full recovery. KANJIDIC2 records kokuji; the visual up/down mnemonic is explicitly not spoken-word etymology.

rows.mappingNote: Correct source gloss while preserving raw fields: 統計 とうけい 1449710:1 means statistics, not scattering/dispersion.
rows.sourceNote: Pinned entry ID is the correct statistics family; actual public body corroborates compiling numerical information. Preserve erroneous raw gloss verbatim. Statistical dispersion being a topic does not make dispersion a general equivalent.

rows.mappingNote: New bodily-movement/bearing and machine-operation article, 動作 どうさ 1451350:1-3.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive 動作する belongs to functioning use; do not mechanically impose it on every bodily movement. Check actual 運動 physical-motion and 働く functioning senses, plus noun/verb neighbors and broad operation labels.

rows.mappingNote: New east-west and cultural-East/West article, 東西 とうざい 1447910:1-2; bounded attention-call recognition sense3.
rows.sourceNote: Call restricted to とうざい; ひがしにし obsolete. Raw whole-country wording is not unrestricted modern equivalence with 全国. Preserve source wording without importing mixed historical headings into ordinary examples.

quizGuardRationale: Direct symmetric nontransitive author hypotheses require review in both directions, including actual secondary meanings and displayed labels. Topic proximity, homophony and noun/verb differences are not automatic decisions.
Bulbs, fixtures and illumination differ; cells may be rechargeable. Utility poles have a specific wire-supporting function. Current, power and energy differ despite broad electricity labels.
Scattered dots and successive transitions are separate てんてん identities; not every gradual change is 点々 or every move 転々. Mimetic overlaps need their actual full senses.
Use actual secondary infection sense of 移る, unity sense of 一致, motion sense of 運動 and functioning sense of 働く, not only their lead English labels.
Rank equality differs from merely having a rank. Passes differ from whole mountains or ridges; critical peaks can overlap other peak words without making every temporal boundary a peak.
Statistics differ from the source's wrong scattering gloss and from merely gathering survey data. Inquiry concerns actual questioning, while operation includes both bodily bearing and functioning.
